questions.prompt: Notice: The 3 P.M. product demonstration has been moved from Room 204 to the main auditorium because attendance is higher than expected. What can be inferred?

choices.B: More people plan to attend than originally anticipated.

questions.explanation: The room changed because expected attendance increased.

questions.prompt: Please ___ the attached invoice before forwarding it to the finance department.
questions.explanation: 'Look over' means to review or inspect something briefly.

questions.prompt: The warehouse manager ordered ___ additional scanner for the shipping desk.
questions.explanation: 'Additional' starts with a vowel sound, so 'an' is used before it.

questions.prompt: The technician ___ repaired the printer will return tomorrow to inspect the scanner.
questions.explanation: 'Who' is the subject of the relative clause referring to a person.

questions.prompt: The accounting team asked employees ___ all travel receipts by Friday.
questions.explanation: ask + someone + to do something is the correct structure.

questions.prompt: By the time the client arrives, the proposal ___ by the design team.
questions.explanation: Future perfect passive fits an action completed before a future time.

questions.prompt: The new software update will be installed ___ after the office closes.
questions.explanation: An adverb is needed to modify the verb phrase 'will be installed'.

questions.prompt: The company will ___ a new training program for all supervisors next month.
questions.explanation: 'Launch' means to start or introduce a new program or product.

vocabulary.meaning: to change or correct a document
vocabulary.example: The contract was amended after legal review.
The device meets all technical specifications.

vocabulary.meaning: to discuss terms and reach an agreement
vocabulary.example: The vendor negotiated a lower delivery fee.
The company will reimburse travel expenses.

vocabulary.meaning: to assign a task to another person

vocabulary.example: The policy ensures compliance with safety regulations.

vocabulary.meaning: an extension of a contract or license
vocabulary.example: The license renewal is due next week.
The meeting date is still tentative.
The documents were sent by courier.
The printer includes a two-year warranty.
